description: List the Canton Foundation Dev Fund Requests for Proposals (RFPs) from the 2026-2028 roadmap: number, title, category, and how many Dev Fund proposals declare each one. Pass number to read one RFP in full: what the Foundation asks for, its stated appetite for grants, prior funded examples, and the proposals declaring it. RFP numbers are the ones proposals and labels use (RFP 18 is Integration into SDLCs). A proposal counts only if a label, its PR text, its title or its proposal file names the RFP, and most proposals do not, so a low count is not proof that an area is uncrowded. Canton-specific. To find the RFP that fits an idea use find_rfp_for_idea.

number.description: RFP number to read in full, e.g. 18. Omit to list every RFP.

name: list_rfps
